findings.label: Razorpay keys still blank
findings.detail: RAZORPAY_KEY_ID= and RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET= are empty strings in .env. Every POST /payments/orders call returns 503 and no appointment row is inserted. The user must obtain test keys from the Razorpay dashboard (Settings → API Keys → Test mode) and fill them in before the payment and data-flow fix takes effect.

findings.label: Weak SECRET_KEY in .env
findings.detail: The written value 'replace-this-with-a-long-random-secret-key' is a well-known mnemonic placeholder that passes the min_length=32 validator. Any environment using this value issues JWTs that can be forged by anyone who knows the string. A randomly generated value (python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))") should be used instead, even for local development.

findings.label: Deprecated on_event startup hook
findings.detail: The new _check_config function uses @app.on_event('startup'), deprecated since FastAPI 0.93. Replace with a lifespan context manager passed to FastAPI(lifespan=...) to eliminate the deprecation warning on every server start.
